groups.name: Women’s Book Club
groups.description: Throughout the year, this group of women choose a book and then meet weekly for fellowship and faith-filled discussion. When a book study has been chosen, information will be in the weekly bulletin.

groups.name: Religious Education for Children
groups.description: Teaches children the faith of the Catholic Church through word and example. Classes begin in September and end in May.

groups.name: Ladies Guild
groups.description: The Ladies’ Guild at Saint Joseph’s exists to build community among women of the parish through spiritual, social, and charitable activities. In a busy, secular world, the Ladies’ Guild is a refreshing way to develop fellowship with other Catholic women…

groups.name: Youth Group
groups.description: Join fellow high school students for faith, fellowship, and fun! We meet at the Johnson’s house from 7 pm – 8:30 pm the 2nd & 4th Wednesdays of the month.

groups.name: Altar Servers
groups.description: Altar Servers are youth age 9-15 who assist a priest during Mass. Their name comes from the Latin word “ministrare” which means ‘’to serve’’. Training needed.

groups.name: Lectors
groups.description: The lector is instituted to proclaim the readings from Sacred Scripture, with the exception of the Gospel. He or she may also announce the intentions for the Universal Prayer and, in the absence of a psalmist, recite the Psalm between…

groups.name: Ushers / Greeters
groups.description: Ushers and Greeters are the ministers of hospitality. They promote a sense of welcoming and belonging to our parishioners as they arrive and attend mass.
